lead: `?T ?? <literal>` is `mixed`, so it cannot feed a slot whose type is named.
body: `$total = $total + (Core\Arr::first($a) ?? 0)` does not compile against `uint $total`, and neither does `array<int> $held = Core\Arr::first($outer) ?? [];` — both are `E0401`, `found mixed`. `echo` accepts it, so a proof program only fails where a type is written down: bind `?uint $v = Core\Arr::first($a);` and branch on `$v != null`.
